newsitem.title: USA: General Comm sees positive cash flow in Q4.
newsitem.headline: General Comm sees positive cash flow in Q4.

text.p: General Communication Inc said Friday it expects some of its new business opportunities to begin generating positive cash flow in the fourth quarter of this year.

The company said it has invested in new lines of business such as local telephone service and wireless PCS development, and they have caused an expected short term impacts on operating costs and earnings.
The company reported a loss in the first quarter of $0.01 per share compared to a profit of $0.09 for the same period a year ago.
